messages:
Claire: Quick docfix: API reference /v1/generate still shows `temperature` range 0-1 but runtime accepts 0-2. Filed PR to update schema + examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/921
Diego: Good catch. We bumped the tunable range for certain models. Docs should include a short note "model-specific ranges may differ" and show example with temp 1.5.
DocsBot: lint: openapi/generate.yaml: parameter.temperature schema maximum mismatch (1 vs 2). examples/generate.md: example uses "temperature":"1" (string).
Rina: Also the Go SDK sample uses GenerateParams{Model: "redwood-1"} but we standardized on ModelID field name. Update to ModelID. Add migration note: server maps legacy Model to ModelID for now.
Owen: I'll update the OpenAPI, regenerate reference snippets, and fix the example code blocks. Proposed curl example: `-d '{"model_id":"redwood-1","prompt":"Hi","temperature":1.5,"max_tokens":40}'`. Will push to PR 921.
Claire: Please ensure `max_tokens` is integer (no quotes) and response example includes `usage` and `model_id` fields. Also add a one-line changelog entry under "API reference updates".
DocsBot: PR #921: checks updated, docs build queued -> https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2468
Diego: thanks team — I'll review after CI. If green, merge and let product know about the temp range note so release notes can mention it.
